name: Vertov
tagline: Browser screen recording with transcript editing and share links
description: Record a screen, microphone or camera in the browser. Edit the recording by deleting words from the transcript, then send a link viewers can open without a Vertov account. The AGPL-3.0 recorder can be self-hosted. The hosted service adds a shared video library and an OAuth connection for AI agents.

replaces.note: Edit recordings by transcript and share a workspace library under one price, with no per-seat fees.
